freshdesk_domain.description: Your full Freshdesk domain, e.g. yourcompany.freshdesk.com (no https://, no trailing slash).

freshdesk_api_key.description: From your Freshdesk profile settings. Needed to read tickets and conversations and to publish article updates.

anthropic_api_key.description: Used for step extraction (Haiku) and patch drafting (Sonnet). If the key is missing or the call fails, the app falls back to deterministic taxonomy matching and a template patch.

admin_emails.description: Comma-separated Freshdesk agent emails allowed to approve, edit or reject a patch. Leave blank to allow anyone who can open the app. This controls the buttons, not the data-pipe - restrict who can open the app for a real boundary.

demo_mode.description: Raises an alert from a single ticket instead of requiring 4 tickets from 3 different agents. Turn this ON to see the full pipeline from one simulated ticket. Leave OFF in production.

provision_hedging.description: When on, the bot may share an unapproved provisional path for Critical alerts. Leave OFF in production.

publish_mode.description: demo publishes approved patches immediately; production saves them as drafts for manual release.
